senses.sense_definition: A large building or facility used for storing goods, equipment, or supplies.

senses.sense_definition: A concentrated amount of medication deposited in the body to be absorbed gradually over a period of time.

examples.text: The patient received a <w>depot</w> injection that releases the drug slowly over several weeks.

target_lang_translations.ru: Пациент получил инъекцию <w>депо</w>-препарата, который медленно высвобождает лекарство в течение нескольких недель.
target_lang_translations.nl: De patiënt kreeg een <w>depot-injectie</w> die het medicijn gedurende enkele weken langzaam afgeeft.
target_lang_translations.pl: Pacjent otrzymał zastrzyk <w>typu depo</w>, który uwalnia lek powoli przez kilka tygodni.
target_lang_translations.de: Der Patient erhielt eine <w>Depotspritze</w>, die das Medikament über mehrere Wochen hinweg langsam freisetzt.
target_lang_translations.fr: Le patient a reçu une injection <w>dépôt</w> qui libère le médicament lentement sur plusieurs semaines.
target_lang_translations.it: Il paziente ha ricevuto un'iniezione <w>deposito</w> che rilascia il farmaco lentamente nel corso di diverse settimane.

target_lang_translations.zh: 病人接受了一次<w>长效制剂</w>注射，药物会在几周内缓慢释放。
